summary: KKR FS Income Trust filed an 8-K reporting routine unregistered sales under its continuous private offering. On September 1, 2026, it issued 127,341.992 Class I shares for about $3.705 million to accredited investors under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. NAV per Class I share was $29.10 as of August 31, 2026; aggregate NAV was about $1.662 billion. The offering is continuous, capped at $5.0 billion, with 60,210,198.798 Class I shares sold for roughly $1.769 billion to date. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or special-situation mechanics; this is an ordinary interval-fund capital-raising update, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
